observations: After all six truth sheets: publisher rectangles often contain much more background than the named visible-body masks, or are shifted relative to the visible silhouette. Every reviewed case still shows a real cow under the named box. Cases5 and11 show a clearly visible animal but no corresponding publisher rectangle. Crowded extremities and fast-motion blur prevent exact outline adjudication from the sheets. Case23 and cases32/33 have especially broad publisher rectangles relative to the main body.
identity_limit: I did not independently establish every biological name from original enrollment and intervening video. Coherent geometry is not proof that the current name is correct.
decision: Keep every one of the34 errors and the failed original gate. Inspect source annotation semantics before attempting a different display geometry; do not change boxes, labels, match threshold or score based on these selected error images.
